propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) have no test exercising pagination beyond the first page; existing coverage only validates single-page payloads with isLast=True
The cursor contract termination logic ('if isLast: break' OR 'if not nextPageToken: break') is never tested in isolation or with multi-page responses, leaving regression vulnerabilities undetected

A server returning identical nextPageToken values causes these readers to spin forever without the same-token-twice guard that exists in fetcher._iter_pages, resulting in silent truncation due to fail-open exception handling

The three readers paginate using opaque cursor tokens echoed from responses, not offset arithmetic, so they are structurally protected from the DC-family short-page bug but lack AST guards preventing future unpaginated callers on Cloud
